an3.96:1.1: Tīhi bhikkhave aṅgehi samannāgato rañño bhaddo assājānīyo rājāraho hoti rājabhoggo rañño aṅgan t' eva saṅkhaṃ gacchati.
an3.96:1.3: Idha bhikkhave rañño bhaddo assājānīyo vaṇṇasampanno ca hoti balasampanno ca javasampanno ca.
an3.96:1.4: Imehi kho bhikkhave tīhi aṅgehi samannāgato rañño bhaddo assājānīyo rājāraho hoti rājabhoggo rañño aṅgan t' eva saṅkhaṃ gacchati. 2.
an3.96:1.5: Evam eva kho bhikkhave tīhi dhammehi samannāgato bhikkhu āhuneyyo hoti pāhuneyyo dakkhiṇeyyo añjalikaraṇīyo anuttaraṃ puññakkhettaṃ lokassā ti.
an3.96:1.7: Idha bhikkhave bhikkhu vaṇṇasampanno ca hoti balasampanno ca javasampanno ca. 3.
an3.96:2.1: Kathañ ca bhikkhave bhikkhu vaṇṇasampanno hoti?
an3.96:2.2: Idha bhikkhave bhikkhu sīlavā hoti pātimokkhasaṃvarasaṃvuto viharati ācāragocarasampanno aṇumattesu vajjesu bhayadassāvī samādāya sikkhati sikkhāpadesu,
an3.96:2.3: evaṃ kho bhikkhave bhikkhu vaṇṇasampanno hoti. 4.
an3.96:3.1: Kathañ ca bhikkhave bhikkhu balasampanno hoti?
an3.96:3.2: Idha bhikkhave bhikkhu āraddhaviriyo viharati, akusalānaṃ dhammānaṃ pahānāya kusalānaṃ dhammānaṃ upasampadāya thāmavā daḷhaparakkamo anikkhittadhuro kusalesu dhammesu,
an3.96:3.3: evaṃ kho bhikkhave bhikkhu balasampanno hoti. 5.
an3.96:4.1: Kathañ ca bhikkhave bhikkhu javasampanno hoti?
an3.96:4.2: Idha bhikkhave bhikkhu idaṃ dukkhan ti yathābhūtaṃ pajānāti
an3.96:4.5: ayaṃ dukkhanirodhagāminī paṭipadā ti yathābhūtaṃ pajānāti,
an3.96:4.6: evaṃ kho bhikkhave bhikkhu javasampanno hoti.
an3.96:4.7: Imehi kho bhikkhave tīhi dhammehi samannāgato bhikkhu āhuneyyo hoti . . . pe . . . anuttaraṃ puññakkhettaṃ lokassā
